newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-GIBBS TO REPLACE HUMPHREYS AS CAPTAIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-GIBBS TO REPLACE HUMPHREYS AS CAPTAIN.

text.p: Wales captain Jonathan Humphreys will definitely miss Saturday's international against the United States after being sent off in last weekend's European Cup semifinals.
Humphreys has decided not to appeal against a seven-day suspension imposed following the first dismissal of his career in Cardiff's 26-13 defeat at French club Brive.
Swansea centre Scott Gibbs was named as Humphreys' replacement by coach Kevin Bowring on Tuesday.
"It is a one-off opportunity to develop leadership skills while Jonathan is unavailable," said Bowring, hinting strongly that Humphreys would be back for the Five Nations tournament.
